t: From Jupyter Exploration to Pipulate Execution: A Workflow Story
s: This article details a pragmatic software development workflow where Jupyter Notebooks serve as an exploratory sandbox for complex workflows, which are then deliberately ported to the Pipulate framework, prioritizing fluency and mastery over strict DRY principles.
sub: Jupyter Notebooks as an exploratory development environment.
Pipulate framework: Core, Apps, and Workflows.
Embracing WET (Write Everything Twice) over DRY for workflow expressiveness.
HTMX and FastHTML for web development.
Ikigai concept applied to professional and personal work convergence.
